# Volume I · Systems Foundations <span class='zh-inline'>(卷一 · 系统基础)</span>

> 本卷回答一个问题：程序如何在真实的机器上执行？
> This volume asks: how does a program actually execute on real hardware?

## Central questions (核心问题)

1. 内存是如何组织的？当程序员写下 `malloc(24)` 时，机器做了什么？
   *How is memory organized? What happens when the programmer writes `malloc(24)`?*
2. 进程是什么？操作系统如何在多个进程之间分配 CPU？
   *What is a process? How does the OS allocate CPU among processes?*
3. 缓存为什么存在？为什么顺序访问比跨步访问快？
   *Why do caches exist? Why is sequential access faster than strided access?*

> **English:** The four case studies are ordered by abstraction level: allocator (raw memory) → cache (memory hierarchy) → scheduler (CPU sharing) → shell (process interface).
